description: A one-cycle waveform player with a four-stage envelope, a tuning input and polyphonic pitch tracking

params.text: Tunes the waveform up or down two octaves, in semitones
Sets how long the envelope takes to rise, 1ms to 10 seconds
Sets how long the envelope takes to fall to the sustain level, 1ms to 10 seconds
Sets the level the envelope holds at, 0% to 100%
Sets how long the envelope takes to fall to silence, 1ms to 10 seconds
Plays the waveform backwards, from its end towards its start
Reverses the playback direction each time the waveform reaches either end, instead of jumping back
Loads the previous file in the same folder
Loads the next file in the same folder

inputs.text: Opens the envelope and plays the waveform for as long as it is held high; its channel count sets the polyphony
Shifts the output volume, scaled by the trimpot beside it and added to the MASTER knob
Shifts the tuning, scaled by the trimpot beside it and added to the TUNE knob
Raises the playback pitch one octave per volt; a polyphonic cable here plays one voice per channel
Lengthens the attack, scaled by the trimpot beside it and added to the ATT knob
Lengthens the decay, scaled by the trimpot beside it and added to the DEC knob
Shifts the sustain level, scaled by the trimpot beside it and added to the SUS knob
Lengthens the release, scaled by the trimpot beside it and added to the REL knob

outputs.text: The waveform at the envelope's level and the set volume

notes: nothing plays until a waveform is loaded: right-click the panel and use Load Sample, or right-click the display area.
this module expects a one-cycle waveform file; it loops the whole file continuously for as long as the gate is high.
menu: Load Sample — opens a file chooser for the waveform this module plays
Select Samples Root — picks a folder, after which a Samples Browser submenu appears for loading
Anti-aliasing filter — adds two-times oversampling and a 20kHz lowpass before the output
Polyphonic OUTs — carries the V/Oct polyphony through to the output; with it off every voice is summed into a single-channel output
Polyphonic Master IN — lets the MASTER CV jack take a polyphonic cable matching the V/Oct channels, for per-voice velocity
Disable NAV Buttons — stops the panel navigation buttons from loading anything, so they cannot be pressed by accident
Store Sample in Patch — saves the loaded waveform inside the patch file, which can make it very large
